title: Peel and Chop an Onion
summary: The person peeled garlic over a compost bin, grabbed an onion from a bag, and is now peeling the onion's papery skin; next they will trim, halve, and chop it on a cutting board.

nodes.name: Peel garlic cloves over bin
nodes.instruction_novice: Pinch and pull the papery skin off each garlic clove, dropping the skins into the bin.
nodes.end_state: Clean white garlic cloves are in hand with skins in the bin.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel garlic cloves over bin?

nodes.name: Grab an onion from the bag
nodes.instruction_novice: Take one onion out of the produce bag on the counter.
nodes.end_state: A whole onion is held in both hands.

checks.question: Is this step done: Grab an onion from the bag?

nodes.name: Peel the onion's outer skin
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick at the dry outer layer with your fingers and peel it away over the bin. Remove any soft or damaged layer too.
nodes.end_state: The onion is pale and smooth with no brown skin left.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the onion's outer skin?

nodes.name: Rinse the onion
nodes.instruction_novice: Give the peeled onion a quick rinse under cold water and pat it dry.
nodes.end_state: The clean onion sits on a dry cutting board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Rinse the onion?

nodes.name: Trim the stem end
nodes.instruction_novice: Lay the onion on the cutting board and slice off the pointed stem end. Leave the hairy root end on to hold it together.
nodes.end_state: The onion has a flat cut top and an intact root end.

checks.question: Is this step done: Trim the stem end?

nodes.name: Halve through the root
nodes.instruction_novice: Stand the onion on its flat end and cut straight down through the root into two halves.
nodes.end_state: Two onion halves lie cut side down on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Halve through the root?

nodes.name: Make lengthwise cuts
nodes.instruction_novice: With your fingertips curled, slice each half lengthwise toward the root without cutting through it.
nodes.end_state: Each half shows parallel slits that are still joined at the root.

checks.question: Is this step done: Make lengthwise cuts?

nodes.name: Cross-cut into dice
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn the half and slice across the slits to make small pieces, working back toward the root.
nodes.end_state: A pile of diced onion sits on the board with only the root stubs left.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cross-cut into dice?

nodes.name: Discard root and scraps
nodes.instruction_novice: Throw the root ends and any scraps into the bin.
nodes.end_state: Only the diced onion remains on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Discard root and scraps?

nodes.name: Transfer onion to bowl or pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Scrape the diced onion into a bowl or pan using the back of your knife.
nodes.end_state: The diced onion is in a bowl or pan and the board is empty.

checks.question: Is this step done: Transfer onion to bowl or pan?
